name: Spherical Gaussian Shading
definition: A shading technique using a Spherical Gaussian (SG) representation for lighting and BRDF to allow fast, analytic integration and automatic differentiation, at the cost of some high-frequency features.
summary: Spherical Gaussian Shading approximates illumination using Gaussian basis functions for fast, analytic integration, distinguishing itself from Monte Carlo methods by being less expensive and robust to roughness variations.
